lastSummary: NC-005 fixed: Webview messages now validated at runtime before the extension host acts on them. (1) validateWebviewMessage() checks type discriminator is a recognized string, validates required fields per message type (prompt non-empty, editId non-empty, filePath non-null-bytes, setting key in allowlist, taskId/requestId/approved present and correct types), enforces size limits (1MB message, 500K prompt, 4K file path, 100K setting value). (2) handleOpenFile() now validates filePath against workspace root via validateOpenFilePath() — rejects paths outside workspace, traversal, and null bytes. (3) updateSetting now rejects any key not in a hardcoded allowlist of 13 safe settings (defaultModel, defaultProvider, openAIBaseUrl, ollamaBaseUrl, autoApproveWrite, toolApproval, maxConcurrentTasks, showReasoning, theme, searchProvider, searchBaseUrl, mcpServers). Secret keys (openAIApiKey, searchApiKey, tavilyApiKey) are explicitly excluded. 71 new regression tests in agent-core/tests/webviewValidation.test.ts. 759/759 tests pass. Build clean. Type-check clean.
